name: Dragonmaw Shinbones

meta.previous: Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards

summary: In the Undercity, Velora Nitely sends Horde warriors to gather Dragonmaw Shinbones for Brutal Legguards. The hunt leads to the southern Wetlands, where the hostile orcs carry bones thick enough to brace the armor.

sections.title: A Gruesome Armature
sections.body: Velora Nitely, a Forsaken armorer in the Undercity, needs a strong brace for Brutal Legguards. She sends Horde warriors to the Wetlands for thick, resilient bone from the Dragonmaw orcs. Their dense frames can bear the heavy blows a seasoned warrior faces.

sections.title: Testing the Marrow
sections.body: Velora needs more than any bone taken from the Dragonmaw. Each one must withstand a hand test; a bone that snaps is too brittle for the forge. Warriors scour the renegade camps along the Wetlands' crags, breaking weak specimens until eight sturdy shinbones remain.

faq.q: Why does Velora Nitely need orc shinbones specifically?
faq.answer: Velora needs thick, dense bone to brace the Brutal Legguards. She judges the Dragonmaw orcs' heavy frames better suited to the work than ordinary game or scavenged remains.

faq.q: Why are the Dragonmaw orcs fair game for Horde warriors?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw remnants in the Wetlands are hostile renegades still tied to the dark legacy of the Second War. They owe no allegiance to Thrall's Horde, so Horde warriors may hunt them as enemies.

faq.q: Where are the Dragonmaw found for this task?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw are in the Wetlands, south across the Thandol Span from the Arathi Highlands. Warriors hunt near the mountainous bluffs of Angerfang Encampment, southwest of the main northern highway.

faq.q: Why do so many of the bones break during the quest?
faq.answer: Velora needs the densest bones for the armor's frame. Warriors test each one by hand and discard any that snap under force, since brittle bone cannot protect a warrior's legs in battle.
Velora Nitely is a Forsaken armorer in the Undercity. Gruff and morbidly dry, she uses grim humor while helping Horde warriors make specialized gear for battle-hardened veterans.

faq.q: What armor piece is forged from these bones?
faq.answer: The bones frame the Brutal Legguards, durable mail legguards made for mid-level Horde warriors.

angles.text: As a warrior, you test your strength in the field and gather grim materials to make stronger armor.
As a member of the Horde, you weaken a dangerous Old Horde remnant in Khaz Modan and strengthen Thrall's coalition.
As an orc loyal to Orgrimmar, you face the unrepentant Dragonmaw and the violent cost of your people's redemption from their fel past.
As an undead, you see Velora Nitely put humanoid remains to practical use, as the Forsaken make use of every resource, however grim.
